An '''unidentified droid model''' used by the [[Pirates of Tarnoonga]] aboard the ''[[Demolisher]]''.

==History==
While captive aboard the ''[[Demolisher]]'', [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were assigned by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] to work with a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of unidentified model loading missiles in preparation for an attack on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]]. As the unidentified droid operated the conveyor belt that carried the missiles, R2-D2 intentionally loaded one of the missiles backward. Once the missile was set to be launched, it would backfire, damaging the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate's]] stolen [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. To prevent his sabotage from being discovered, R2-D2 maneuvered a large overhead electromagnet over to the weapons droid, picked the droid up, and dropped it on the conveyor belt along with the missiles.

==Behind the scenes==
An identical droid of the same model and color also appeared in the [[1986]] [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] TV special ''[[The Great Heep]]''.
